name: Time Series Imputation Real-World Test Cases Benchmark
description: Benchmarks missing-data imputation methods for time series using real-world test cases to measure robustness and accuracy across scenarios.
reputation: Moderately used in academic research for evaluating robustness of imputation methods on real-world time series; not a single community-wide standard.
notes: Real-world missingness patterns (non-random) and heterogeneous scales make comparisons dataset-dependent; small/heterogeneous test cases and preprocessing choices (scaling, windowing) strongly affect scores; non-LLM benchmark.
